nodes.label: Post Clustering Synthesis Gate
nodes.rationale: Optional Gemini synthesis runs only after 20 topics and mean c_v at least 0.4; it never changes memberships, weights, coherence, or stability, and invalid responses prevent publication.

nodes.label: Multilingual SBERT Embeddings
nodes.rationale: Immutable MiniLM revision produces 384-dimensional native safetensors embeddings; overflow windows are averaged and L2 normalized, with pretrained neural weights unchanged.

nodes.label: Two Seed UMAP Projection
nodes.rationale: UMAP uses 10 dimensions with seeds 42 and 43; original SBERT embeddings remain the evaluation space.

nodes.label: Euclidean DBSCAN Clustering
nodes.rationale: DBSCAN fits UMAP-space density groups, preserves zero-distance edges, bounds radius-graph memory, and retains noise as -1 without invented probabilities.

nodes.label: Sentence Weighted Ward Reduction
nodes.rationale: Weighted Ward merges entire DBSCAN groups in original SBERT space until target_topics is reached; DBSCAN groups are not split and noise remains unassigned.

nodes.label: Class Based TF IDF Labels
nodes.rationale: Cluster-level term counts use L1 TF and log(1 + average cluster-document length / total term count); labels use unigrams and bigrams but do not provide clustering features.

nodes.label: Topic Model Quality Gate
nodes.rationale: Candidates require configured target topic counts on both seeds, valid silhouette, coverage at least 0.4, largest assigned cluster fraction at most 0.5, and mean c_v at least 0.4; failure stops fitting rather than loosening thresholds.

nodes.label: Gensim C V Coherence Protocol
